header.running_head: Relationships between Men, Women and Children

blocks.text: one of them (the narrator is unsure) arrived and climbed upon his back. When Rasulullaah ﷺ got up, he held the child or the two children with his hand and (after completing the salaah) said, "What an excellent mount you had mounted." [^1]

Hadhrat Jaabir (RA) says that he once went to Rasulullaah ﷺ as he was on all fours with Hadhrat Hasan (RA) and Hadhrat Husayn (RA) on his back. Rasulullaah ﷺ was saying, "You two have an excellent camel and are both excellent loads." [^2]
The Incident of Rasulullaah ﷺ with Hadhrat Hasan (RA) and Hadhrat Husayn (RA) when they Got Lost

Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) reports that it was midday when they were sitting around Rasulullaah ﷺ and Hadhrat Ummu Ayman (RA) arrived saying, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Hasan (RA) and Husayn (RA) are lost!" Rasulullaah ﷺ said to the Sahabah (RA), "Get up and look for my sons!" Every person went in the direction he was facing and Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) went in the direction Rasulullaah ﷺ went. Rasulullaah ﷺ kept searching until he was at the foot of a mountain when he saw the two boys clinging on to each other. In front of them was a snake standing on its tail with flames flashing from its mouth (Allaah had perhaps sent it to ensure that the boys ventured no further). As Rasulullaah ﷺ darted towards it, it turned to look at him and then slid away into a hole. Rasulullaah ﷺ then went to the boys and as he separated them, he wiped their faces saying, "May my parents be sacrificed for you! How honourable you two are in the sight of Allaah!" When he then carried one of them on his right shoulder and the other on his left shoulder, Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) remarked, "Glad tidings to you two. What an excellent mount you have!" To this, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "What excellent riders are they and their father is even better than them." [^3]

Hadhrat Jaabir (RA) says, "We were with Rasulullaah ﷺ when we were invited for a meal. When we came across Husayn (RA) playing with other children in the street, Rasulullaah ﷺ ran ahead of the others and stretched out his hands (to grab the boy). Husayn (RA) started running to and fro as Rasulullaah ﷺ made him laugh in front of everyone there. Rasulullaah ﷺ then stretched out his arms and held the boy with one hand on his chin and the other between his head and ears. Thereafter, Rasulullaah ﷺ hugged and kissed him saying, 'Husayn is from me and I am from him. May Allaah love those who love him. Hasan (RA) and Husayn (RA) are two (distinguished) grandsons from amongst grandsons.'" [^4]
Tabraani, reporting from reliable sources as confirmed by Haythami (Vol.9 Pg.182).
Tabraani. Haythami (Vol.9 Pg.182) has commented on the chain of narrators.
